scope: Backend task authorization foundation; not public UI/lifecycle binding
implementation: RAM-only host-issued logical-task scopes with exact resource/action grants
Exact-request high-impact approvals independent of task-duration input handover
Host-selected authorization_id outside model arguments, validated by shared policy at worker dispatch
Revocation prevents later authorization checks; restart/journal history never restore grants
Unscoped serialization and existing replay fingerprints preserved

initial_failures.detail: 60 ms synthetic timeout produced no text before expiry. Passed isolated and on full rerun; scheduling/load cause inferred, not proven.
Added result/error None narrowing; application type check clean.

limits: No issuance/UI/preference/lifecycle integration in desktop bootstrap yet; full 7.P2 open
Real target identity/freshness and filesystem/browser/window/person bindings require 7.P3
Task end/Stop cancellation and pending human approval UI require 7.P4/7.P2b
Revocation is not hard cancellation of already authorized/in-flight effects
Policy-denied requests are terminal; same request ID cannot resurrect them after approval
No provider/API call, physical input to user apps or access to actual user files
No new full native run; previous intermittent native and timing limits remain open
Manual acceptance pending; no commit/push of 7.P2a
